newsitem.title: FINLAND: IVO SAYS DEAL TO BUY FORSMARK POWER FAILS.
newsitem.headline: IVO SAYS DEAL TO BUY FORSMARK POWER FAILS.

text.p: Finnish state-controlled power group Imatran Voima Oy said in a statement on Wednesday its letter of intent to purchase 0.6 percent of shares in and output of Sweden's Forsmark nuclear power plant had not been finalised.
IVO said in September it had agreed with the Swedish city of Karlstad to buy shares corresponding to 19 megawatts (MW) of power of the Forsmark facility's total capacity of 3,095 MW.
Two other Forsmark owners, Stora Kraft AB and Gullspangs Kraft AB had used their redemption rights and acquired the shares targetted by IVO for a total of about 101 million Swediah crowns, IVO said.

Through other shareholdings, IVO has the right to about one percent or some 30 MW of Forsmark's output, it said, adding its Gullspang subsidiary held some 750 MW of Sweden's nuclear power plants' 10,040 MW electricity output capacity.
